comparison.objective: Flip a pancake in a pan with a turner; unlike shock-absorber commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pan stabilization, blade insertion under a compliant object, and controlled flipping; no fastener or adjustment mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Pancake inverted in pan, turner returned, pan released, and arms retracted. Spill/damage thresholds and spec versions are not stated.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization is generic; the core utensil insertion and flipping ability is unrelated.
